sampling_policy.scope: Stop remaining 100-signature proving runs. Preserve every completed result and interrupted attempt; complete article, figures and read-only validation.
sampling_policy.g100_point_classification: one fully verified measured pipeline, not a three-pipeline median
sampling_policy.g100_curve_policy: Display actual single-run result distinctly and disclose sample count. Keep the separate heuristic forecast outside measured data.
sampling_policy.g100_verification_policy: The one independent public-only receiver still records three prepared verification calls; this does not constitute three producer pipelines.

policy: Measured results only; three fresh tree pipelines per point except Raccoon-G at 100 signatures (one). No estimates enter curves.
validation_scope: Frozen measured sources, final receipt and public-statement hashes, complete receiver records, all component timings and G part coverage. Intermediate proof files are omitted; their hashes and sizes remain in the reports. This command does not rerun cryptographic verification.
